name: air_cooler_air_side
title: Air-cooled heat exchanger, air side: finned-bundle HTC, pressure drop and fan noise (function library)
summary: Eight EES FUNCTIONs for the air side of an air cooler (a finned tube bundle crossed by air): the air-side heat-transfer coefficient on a bare-tube basis (Briggs-Young, ESDU high-fin, ESDU low-fin, Ganguli/VDI), the air-side pressure drop across the bundle (ESDU high-fin and low-fin) and the sound pressure level of a one-fan bay (GPSA, Mukherjee). Three helper functions complete the family: the Kern-Kraus circular-fin efficiency and the two modified Bessel functions it needs, evaluated by their power series. All arguments are the geometry of the bundle and the air properties; no property function is called inside the functions.

authors: D. E. Briggs and E. H. Young (Briggs-Young correlation)
A. Ganguli, S. S. Tung and J. Taborek (Ganguli correlation, AIChE Symposium Series 81)
V. D. I. Gesellschaft (VDI Heat Atlas, 2nd edition)
ESDU 86022 and ESDU 73031 (high-fin staggered tube banks; convective heat transfer over plain tube banks)
G. L. Hewitt, G. L. Shires and T. R. Bott (Process Heat Transfer, where the ESDU formulas are presented)
R. Mukherjee and G. Hewitt (Practical Thermal Design of Air-Cooled Heat Exchangers, 2007)
D. Q. Kern and A. D. Kraus (Extended Surface Heat Transfer, 1972)

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/air_cooler.py (case A) and additional values computed with the same ht functions in a throw-away virtualenv (case B); the modified Bessel functions compared with scipy.special.iv/kv and the fin efficiency with the ht doctest of fin_efficiency_Kern_Kraus; 32 output values in total
